Auth.verificationDesc: To keep Nilamit safe, you need to verify your account before you can place bids or create auctions.

FAQ.title: Frequently Asked Questions
FAQ.subtitle: Everything you need to know about nilamit.
FAQ.a1: Every bid is recorded in real-time. If someone bids in the last 2 minutes, the auction is extended by another 2 minutes to prevent 'sniping'.
FAQ.a2: It is a small commitment fee (logistic insurance) held by the platform to protect both parties. It is unlocked for the seller once the deal is complete.
FAQ.a3: Yes. Your contact information is shielded and only revealed to your counter-party after the escrow advance is confirmed.

Safety.title: Safety & Integrity
Safety.subtitle: Trusted commerce in Bangladesh.
Safety.shieldDesc: We prioritize verified identities. Sellers with high trust scores are prioritized, and all logistics are gated by financial commitments.

Contact.title: Get in Touch
Contact.subtitle: We are here to help you 24/7.

Privacy.title: Privacy Policy
Privacy.subtitle: Your data, protected by our Integrity Shield.
Privacy.s1Desc: We collect your name, email, and phone number solely for the operation of the marketplace.
Privacy.s2Desc: Your data is used to track bids and manage auctions. We never sell your data.
Privacy.s3Desc: We use industry-standard encryption to protect your transaction history.

Terms.title: Terms of Service
Terms.subtitle: Platform agreement for nilamit.
Terms.s1Desc: By using nilamit, you agree to follow our bidding and selling guidelines.
Terms.s2Desc: Every bid is a legal contract. Failure to pay will result in a trust score penalty.
Terms.s3Desc: Sellers must be honest and responsive within the Coordination Hub.

Leaderboard.title: Platform Champions
Leaderboard.subtitle: Discover the most trusted traders in Bangladesh. Earn trust points by participating fairly in auctions.
